ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels dominating the medial and central regions, with 30% high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels localized at the distal tips and in scattered focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity zones on the distal-lateral tips of both lobes; numerous small, discrete circular high-intensity nodes scattered across the dark central interior; subtle yellowish-brown staining on the distal left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide U-shaped depression approximately 95 degrees at the vertex, with smooth transition curves between lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge; frequency increases toward distal tips with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels; left lobe shows more jagged, high-frequency peaks than the right.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature along the trailing edge from the median notch to the outer tips; visible leading edge segments indicate convex distal sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and semi-circular high-contrast pixel clusters (white on black) distributed throughout the central and lower regions of both lobes, representing a high density of attachment scars.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical and diagonal linear disruptions on the left lobe's distal half, intersecting the darker pigmentation regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Structural irregularity and jagged material loss on the outer margin of the left distal tip; heavy white scarring and textural distortion on both fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive 'starfield' pattern of small circular white scars across the central dark areas of both lobes.
